_note: v3.0 52 live pacing-engagement row. Arm = install setting pacing.engagement, set before the run (first step records it). The 2026-11-09 A/B ran with stagecraft.livingEnabled and branchingEnabled off on the lane for both arms: with them on, the living director branched off the gated scene after three relationship turns and the ladder never acted. Gated scene with stuck_after 3 and three leads; twelve FIXED player lines: a relationship stretch with two questions, then a repeating stretch. Each turn keeps the engagement reading, which guidance the prompt carried (rung lead, information line, aftermath) and the replies, for the blind on/off rating (so-engagement-p52.mts pack/rate). Fixed lines never act on a lead, so turns to exit cannot differ between arms.

requires.why: real extraction moves the relationship axis; the guidance block is code

steps.eval: for (const name of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[name]; globalThis.__soP52 = []; const p = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().pacing; return { engagement: p.engagement, stuckLadder: p.stuckLadder };

import_story.description: v3.0 52: a gated search with three leads where the player would rather talk with Arin.

qualities.rubric: Has the player found the missing harbour ledger?

checkpoints.name: The dock
leads: a dockhand mutters that the harbour ledger was moved last night
fresh scratches lead from the office to the back door
a creditor is asking every sailor for the ledger by name
